name: Ki-PIDA (electrical fixes)
description: DC voltage-drop and copper-loss analysis with experimental steady-state thermal estimates.
description_full: Local testing build of Ki-PIDA with corrected electrical geometry, regulator loading, solver validation, CUDA acceleration and mesh convergence checks. Includes an experimental board-average thermal estimate from copper, series-component and regulator losses, with user-specified cooling and substrate conductivity. Current-density and component junction temperature models are not implemented. Uses KiCad's IPC API. Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3; see LICENSE. The open-source metadata category preserves compatibility with KiCad 9's schema, which has no AGPL entry.
